blocks.content: Consider the same tree again, but this time, let's number the nodes.

blocks.alt: Numbered Node Array Representation of a Binary Tree
Array Representation of a Binary Tree

blocks.content: For any node at index i in the array:

items: The left child is located at index 2i.
The right child is located at index 2i + 1.
The parent is located at index floor(i/2).
